1.title: Move green cube to right
1.say: Pick up the green cube from the left tray. Set it in the front right pocket of the right tray.
placements: green small cube → front right pocket of right clear tray, suction tip pressed on top centre, in the video: bottom right pocket nearest the black cable
watch_for: if the cube tips over, the tip missed the centre of the top
if the cube stays behind, the suction did not seal so push straight down
1.check_yourself: It should look like one green cube in the right tray.
1.safety: Keep fingers clear of the moving arm.
